plainTranslation: Their Neptune in your 8th house blurs intimacy, trust, shared resources, and psychological boundaries. This can feel tender and transcendent, but it requires clear agreements. Do not merge finances, secrets, or bodies faster than truth can keep up.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Refined from approved project relationship source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
